title: Hardware Engineer - System Board Design (PCB) (Onsite)
locations: Milpitas, California, United States of America
skills: lab equipment (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers)
teaser: We are expanding our team: As a System Hardware Board Design Engineer, you will design and validate complex ASICs for next-generation AI solutions. You will contribute to system and board design, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and ensure high-quality products. Ideal candidates have hands-on experience in high-speed hardware board design and validation.
description:
The application window is expected to close on: 10/30/2026
Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.

This position requires that you live within commuting distance of our Milpitas, CA office and commute to the lab 5 days per week. 

Meet the Team

The Common Hardware Group (CHG) creates innovative hardware platforms central to the AI era, powering Cisco’s core Switching, Routing, and Wireless products for organizations globally. Our innovations in silicon, optics, and hardware platforms—like Silicon One—are shaping the technology industry. We're a global team of creative experts, bringing our unique backgrounds and bold ideas to push boundaries and help each other grow. Because full product development—from design to qualification to production—is within our team, we’re able to think differently, experiment more, and work quickly. Join us to power the future of the digital world.

Cisco Silicon One is the only unifying silicon architecture in the market that enables customers to deploy the best-of-breed silicon from Top of Rack (TOR) switches through web-scale data centers and across service providers, enterprise networks, and data centers with a fully unified routing and switching portfolio. Come join us and take part in shaping Cisco's ground-breaking solutions by designing, developing, and testing some of the most complex ASICs being developed in the industry.

The Cisco Service Provider Routing Hardware Engineering team develops next-generation hardware by adhering to IEEE standards and industry best practices. Our engineers drive innovation across the full product lifecycle, serving as IP architects, creators, and solution integrators who manage products from concept to production. 

The team specializes in key technical domains, including system and board design, PCB layout, hardware automation, validation, signal integrity, and power design. By partnering cross-functionally with system designers, diagnostics and customer escalation engineers, and external vendors, the team ensures robust test methodologies, timely issue mitigation, and high product quality. Ultimately, they advance the state of the art through IP development and research, consistently challenging industry norms to optimize cost, performance, and reliability for next-generation solutions. 

Your Impact

Own design and validation of a server sub-system.

Ensure design meets functional specs.

Participate as a valuable team member to deliver quality products on time.

Participate in cross-functional meetings and teams.

Participate in creating functional specifications and technical documentation.

Work with and manage JDMs for server product development.

Minimum Qualifications 

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering and 4+ years of experience, or Master’s in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering and 2+ years of related experience, or PhD in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering and 0+ years of related experience.

Experience with highspeed hardware board designs and validation. 

Experience with taking board designs from concept through production including schematics generation, layouts and troubleshooting. 

Experience in hardware validation using lab equipment such as Oscilloscopes, Logic Analyzers, and Spectrum Analyzers.

Hands on board design knowledge, including design tools such as Cadence Concept and Allegro.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with networking products design.

Experience creating test scripts in Python.

Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Effective verbal and written communication skills.

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
